```{python}
#| echo: false
import sys
sys.path.insert(0, ".")

import warnings
warnings.filterwarnings("ignore")

import yaml
import numpy as np
import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns
from utils.helpers import load_processed_data

with open("_params.yml") as f:
    params = yaml.safe_load(f)

st_dict = load_processed_data(params)
```

## Cell counts and transcript assignment

```{python}
rows = []
for method, st in st_dict.items():
    st.bl.num_cells(inplace=True)
    st.bl.perc_unassigned_transcripts(inplace=True)
    st.bl.transcripts_per_cell()
    st.bl.genes_per_cell()
    st.bl.mean_transcripts_per_gene_per_cell()

    obs = st.sdata.tables["table"].obs
    uns = st.sdata.tables["table"].uns

    rows.append({
        "Method": method,
        "# Cells": uns["num_cells"],
        "% Unassigned transcripts": round(uns["perc_unassigned_transcripts"], 2),
        "Mean transcripts/cell": round(obs["transcript_count"].mean(), 2),
        "Median transcripts/cell": round(obs["transcript_count"].median(), 2),
        "Mean genes/cell": round(obs["gene_count"].mean(), 2),
        "Median genes/cell": round(obs["gene_count"].median(), 2),
        "Mean transcripts/gene/cell": round(obs["mean_transcripts_per_gene"].mean(), 2),
    })

df_summary = pd.DataFrame(rows).set_index("Method")
df_summary
```

## Transcript count distribution

```{python}
fig, axes = plt.subplots(1, 2, figsize=(12, 4))

for ax, (method, st) in zip(axes, st_dict.items()):
    obs = st.sdata.tables["table"].obs

    cap = obs["transcript_count"].quantile(0.99)
    data = obs[obs["transcript_count"] <= cap]["transcript_count"]

    ax.hist(data, bins=50, color="steelblue", edgecolor="white", linewidth=0.5)
    ax.axvline(data.median(), color="red", linestyle="--",
               label=f"Median: {data.median():.0f}")
    ax.set_title(method)
    ax.set_xlabel("Transcripts per cell")
    ax.set_ylabel("# Cells")
    ax.legend()

fig.suptitle("Transcript count distribution", y=1.02)
plt.tight_layout()
plt.show()
```

## Gene count distribution

```{python}
fig, axes = plt.subplots(1, 2, figsize=(12, 4))

for ax, (method, st) in zip(axes, st_dict.items()):
    obs = st.sdata.tables["table"].obs

    cap = obs["gene_count"].quantile(0.99)
    data = obs[obs["gene_count"] <= cap]["gene_count"]

    ax.hist(data, bins=50, color="darkorange", edgecolor="white", linewidth=0.5)
    ax.axvline(data.median(), color="red", linestyle="--",
               label=f"Median: {data.median():.0f}")
    ax.set_title(method)
    ax.set_xlabel("Genes per cell")
    ax.set_ylabel("# Cells")
    ax.legend()

fig.suptitle("Gene count distribution", y=1.02)
plt.tight_layout()
plt.show()
```

## Method comparison

```{python}
dfs = []
for method, st in st_dict.items():
    obs = st.sdata.tables["table"].obs.copy()
    obs["method"] = method
    dfs.append(obs[["method", "transcript_count", "gene_count"]])

df_all = pd.concat(dfs, ignore_index=True)

cap_tx = df_all["transcript_count"].quantile(0.99)
cap_gn = df_all["gene_count"].quantile(0.99)

fig, axes = plt.subplots(1, 2, figsize=(12, 4))

sns.violinplot(
    data=df_all[df_all["transcript_count"] <= cap_tx],
    x="method", y="transcript_count",
    palette="Set2", ax=axes[0]
)
axes[0].set_title("Transcripts per cell")
axes[0].set_xlabel("")
axes[0].set_ylabel("# Transcripts")

sns.violinplot(
    data=df_all[df_all["gene_count"] <= cap_gn],
    x="method", y="gene_count",
    palette="Set2", ax=axes[1]
)
axes[1].set_title("Genes per cell")
axes[1].set_xlabel("")
axes[1].set_ylabel("# Genes")

plt.tight_layout()
plt.show()
```

## Transcripts per gene per cell

```{python}
dfs = []
for method, st in st_dict.items():
    obs = st.sdata.tables["table"].obs.copy()
    obs["method"] = method
    dfs.append(obs[["method", "mean_transcripts_per_gene"]])

df_all = pd.concat(dfs, ignore_index=True)
cap = df_all["mean_transcripts_per_gene"].quantile(0.99)

fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(6, 4))

sns.violinplot(
    data=df_all[df_all["mean_transcripts_per_gene"] <= cap],
    x="method", y="mean_transcripts_per_gene",
    palette="Set2", ax=ax
)
ax.set_title("Mean transcripts per gene per cell")
ax.set_xlabel("")
ax.set_ylabel("Transcripts / gene / cell")

plt.tight_layout()
plt.show()
```
